why: Owner report 2026-11-06: the article writer is producing hard-to-read pieces. Four classes hold a publish because they are deterministic (an executive summary at the foot of the page, a bullet carrying two statistics, two citations in one sentence, a run-on source list). The prose classes (read-twice, timeline repetition, cold closing concept) are reported to the rewrite and the reviewer and never hold: they are heuristics over grammar, and a heuristic that cannot see paraphrase must not reject an article. Owner directive 2026-11-07 added the diction and structure classes he named on a live dispatch: private shorthand nouns ('the fact', 'hop owner', 'the wire'), a heading that promises a count without labelling its items, a multi-variable comparison left in prose with no table, and a Sources block whose entries carry no list marker (so the CMS renders one paragraph). Scope: EVERY vertical and every track (news, evergreen, review, SEO) — the checks read the text, never the vertical, and the drafting prompts of all four tracks carry the same rules (skills/story_draft.md §3.6, skills/seo_story_draft.md §2B, skills/review_comparison.md, skills/claude_humanizer.md §3.10, .agents/story_drafter.md, .agents/claude_stylist.md). Owner instruction 2026-11-07: apply to all FUTURE generations, never retrofit the archive.
